about_the_game:
BURROWS

Burrows is an open-world action-adventure game where you play as Thumper, a rabbit on a path of revenge. Armed with a massive, upgradeable slingshot, you'll face off against a wide variety of enemies in both ranged and melee combat. Precision, timing, and strategy are key—every fight is a challenge, and every victory is earned.

Explore a interconnected world filled with hostile creatures. Discover and unlock new slingshot types with unique stats and special abilities, and collect powerful armor sets to customize your playstyle.

Burrows is inspired by Souls-like gameplay—expect punishing bosses, unforgiving environments, and a story told through exploration and atmosphere.

Will you venture out of your burrow?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mild fantasy violence. Most combat features non-bloody effects such as sparks and smoke when enemies are defeated. There are two brief scenes with light blood, but no graphic or realistic depictions. The game does not include sexual content, drug/alcohol use, or themes such as self-harm or sexual assault.
